During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] utilized a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed '''lightsaber''' to replace the [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsabers]] that she used primarily through the [[Great Galactic War]] with the Empire. The weapon was used by Shan during the Cold War, but she eventually returned to using a double-bladed saber by the time of the [[Galactic War]] with the Empire.

This was the fourth lightsaber Satele owned and the only one that was a single-blade that was composed of a silver-[[Color/Legends|colored]] metal, and the thin cylinder sported a gold-colored pommel and [[Blade emitter/Legends|blade emitter]] shroud. The weapon contained a green [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] that generated a green blade.<ref name="Threat of Peace 1" />

==History==
A [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Shan exchanged her normal blue [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] for a single-bladed weapon sometime after the [[Battle of Rhen Var]] near the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the Empire,<ref name="Lost Suns">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref> and Shan took her green-bladed saber with her to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] when she was sent there as part of a delegation to a [[Alderaan peace conference|peace conference]] in [[3653 BBY]]. However, when it was revealed that the conference was a sham and that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were holding the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] hostage in order to force the Republic to accept their terms, Shan drew her weapon and attacked the Sith negotiator [[Darth Baras]]. She later utilized it in combat against Imperial attackers when the vessel she was aboard, the [[Envoy (Republic transport ship)|''Envoy'']], was [[Attack on the Envoy|boarded]] in seeming violation of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and the end of the war.<ref name="Threat of Peace 1" /> The weapon was used by Shan to battle Darth Baras again on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] a short while later, though the [[Skirmish in the Ancient Crystal Cave|fighting]] ended with the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Dar'Nala]] and a withdrawal by all parties involved.<ref name="Threat of Peace 3">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 3: Uncertain Surrender]]''</ref>

[[File:Baras_vs_Satele.jpg|thumb|Baras vs Satele]]
By [[3643 BBY]], Shan was still using the weapon while serving as [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Order, and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Shigar Konshi]] wielded it briefly alongside his own lightsaber to free Shan from the wreckage of the destroyed vessel [[Corellia (starship)|''Corellia'']] above the planet [[Sebaddon]]. Konshi returned the lightsaber to his Master after the rescue, and she wielded it in battle against the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] known as [[Fastbreeder|hexes]] on Sebaddon's surface, an encounter later designated [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]]&mdash;an unofficial joint venture between the Empire and the Republic to destroy the hexes and prevent them from reaching the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> However, Shan soon set aside the single-bladed weapon and took up a double-bladed lightsaber again, and she used that weapon throughout the rest of the Cold War and the subsequent [[Galactic War]] with the Empire.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Attack of the Flesh Raiders|Tython}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Bluesaber_Dantooine.png|thumb|right|160px|''The Journal of Gnost-Dural'' directly contradicted the existence of the green lightsaber.]]
Satele Shan's green lightsaber first appeared in the webcomic series ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace]]'', which served as a lead-up to the release of the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Threat of Peace 1" /> However, as many of the characters' appearances had not yet been finalized in-game, Shan's appearance and choice of lightsaber was among the many discrepancies in the comic.<ref name="Freed on TOR">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=5637093#edit5637093|text=Alexander Freed's post on SWTOR.com, confirming Satele's appearance in ''Hope''|nolive=1}}</ref> The novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', which was also released well before the game, stated that Shan continued to use the lightsaber ten years after the events of the comic,<ref name="Fatal Alliance" /> though all subsequent material starting with the [[Hope (cinematic trailer)|''Hope'' cinematic trailer]] portrayed Shan as wielding several different blue double-bladed lightsabers throughout her life.<ref name="Return">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/return|text="Return"|int=Return (cinematic trailer)}}</ref><ref name="Hope">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/hope-cinematic-trailer|text="Hope"|int=Hope (cinematic trailer)}}</ref> The exception to this would be the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', which begins at the same time as ''Threat of Peace'',<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>

However, the reference guide [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']] depicts Shan as wielding a blue double-bladed lightsaber during the skirmish on Dantooine, directly contradicting the already contentious green lightsaber.<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> The [[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic — The Lost Suns|''The Lost Suns'']] comic arc further added to the discrepancy, as Shan seen with a double-bladed saber at [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] shortly before the events of ''Threat of Peace'',<ref name="Lost Suns" /> and she is also seen in-game with a double-bladed saber not long after the events of ''Fatal Alliance''.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />
